description.en:
Basic Attack - Present Self

Press Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.
Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self

When Dedication reaches 300 points, Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions and incoming DMG in the duration.
When the last arrow is shot, 300 points of Dedication is consumed and Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available. The arrow applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Mid-air Attack - Present Self

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Present Self

Press Normal Attack within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
Press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.

Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self

While in Foreclaimed Self, Basic Attack - Present Self is replaced by Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5 each applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self

In Foreclaimed Self, hold Normal Attack to enter Hold Breath, continuously consuming STA. When Normal Attack is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the Hold Breath state and thrusts forward, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%. Press Normal Attack within a certain period after triggering this effect to chain into Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 instead.

Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self

When Whiteout Bitterfrost is full, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self.
Hold Normal Attack and consume STA and 3 stacks of Whiteout Bitterfrost to gain 1 point of Snowforged Blade, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
If Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.

Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self

While in Foreclaimed Self, Mid-air Attack - Present Self is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Consume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.
Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3 apply Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
The Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self cycle will not be reset by casting skills other than Basic Attack - Iai within a short period.
Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self

While in Foreclaimed Self, Dodge Counter - Present Self is replaced by Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self.
Press Normal Attack within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Present Self

Tekan Normal Attack berturut-turut atau tahan untuk melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG.
Basic Attack - Present Self Tahap 3 memberikan Glacio Chafe sebanyak 1 kali saat mengenai target.

Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self

Saat Dedication mencapai 300 poin, Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self tersedia.
Tahan Normal Attack untuk menembakkan 3 anak panah satu per satu dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki kebal terhadap interupsi dan DMG yang masuk selama durasi ini.
Saat anak panah terakhir ditembakkan, 300 poin Dedication dikonsumsi dan Foreclaiming: Inward Vision tersedia. Anak panah memberikan Glacio Chafe sebanyak 1 kali saat mengenai target.

Mid-air Attack - Present Self

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dari udara, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Present Self

Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Present Self Tahap 3.

Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self

Saat dalam Foreclaimed Self, Basic Attack - Present Self digantikan oleh Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Tahap 3, 4, dan 5 masing-masing memberikan Glacio Chafe sebanyak 1 kali saat mengenai target.

Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self

Dalam Foreclaimed Self, tahan Normal Attack untuk memasuki Hold Breath, terus mengonsumsi STA. Saat Normal Attack dilepas atau STA habis, Hiyuki keluar dari kondisi Hold Breath dan menusuk ke depan, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG. Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Tahap 2.
Jika Hiyuki diserang musuh dalam waktu tertentu selama tusukan, damage tersebut dinetralkan, target di sekitar dibuat terhenti (Stagnate), dan Hiyuki kebal terhadap interupsi untuk beberapa saat setelahnya sambil mengurangi semua DMG yang masuk sebesar 100%. Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah efek ini terpicu untuk menyambung ke Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Tahap 4.

Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self

Saat Whiteout Bitterfrost penuh, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self.
Tahan Normal Attack dan konsumsi STA serta 3 stack Whiteout Bitterfrost untuk mendapat 1 poin Snowforged Blade, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self memberikan Glacio Chafe sebanyak 1 kali saat mengenai target.
Jika Hiyuki sedang di udara saat menggunakan skill ini, ia akan mendarat di tanah terlebih dahulu.

Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self

Saat dalam Foreclaimed Self, Mid-air Attack - Present Self digantikan oleh Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun di udara, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG. Tahap 3 adalah Plunging Attack.
Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Tahap 2 & 3 memberikan Glacio Chafe sebanyak 1 kali saat mengenai target.
Siklus Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self tidak akan diatur ulang oleh penggunaan skill selain Basic Attack - Iai dalam waktu singkat.
Tahan Normal Attack saat di udara untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dengan mengonsumsi STA.

Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self

Saat dalam Foreclaimed Self, Dodge Counter - Present Self digantikan oleh Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self.
Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Tahap 3.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - Present Self

Deal Glacio DMG.
Casting this skill enhances the next Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3, which now restores 100 points of Dedication when cast. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.
Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.

While in Foreclaimed Self, Resonance Skill - Present Self is replaced by Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall:

Frostblight: Jade Cleave

While on the ground, press Resonance Skill to pull in nearby targets and deal Glacio DMG, removing the targets' Frostbind.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Frostblight: Petalfall.

Frostblight: Petalfall

While in mid-air, press Resonance Skill to pull in nearby targets and deal Glacio DMG, removing the targets' Frostbind.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Frostblight: Jade Cleave.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Present Self

Memberikan Glacio DMG.
Menggunakan skill ini meningkatkan Basic Attack - Present Self Tahap 3 berikutnya, yang kini memulihkan 100 poin Dedication saat digunakan. Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri efek ini.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Present Self Tahap 3.

Saat dalam Foreclaimed Self, Resonance Skill - Present Self digantikan oleh Frostblight: Jade Cleave dan Frostblight: Petalfall:

Frostblight: Jade Cleave

Saat di darat, tekan Resonance Skill untuk menarik target di sekitar dan memberikan Glacio DMG, menghapus Frostbind pada target.
Skill ini berbagi Cooldown dengan Frostblight: Petalfall.

Frostblight: Petalfall

Saat di udara, tekan Resonance Skill untuk menarik target di sekitar dan memberikan Glacio DMG, menghapus Frostbind pada target.
Skill ini berbagi Cooldown dengan Frostblight: Jade Cleave.

description.en:
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision

Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available after casting Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self.
While in Present Self, press Resonance Liberation to cast this skill, dealing Glacio DMG. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of Frostharden Iai, remove 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart. Then, enter Foreclaimed Self and restore 50 points of Frostheart.
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision applies 4 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision does not consume Resonance Energy.

Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation

While in Foreclaimed Self, Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation can be cast via the following ways:
- Press Resonance Liberation and release to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If Hiyuki has 3 points of Snowforged Blade, consume all Snowforged Blade. Otherwise, this cast does not consume Snowforged Blade.
- Hold Resonance Liberation to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of Snowforged Blade periodically. Release Resonance Liberation to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If no Snowforged Blade is consumed when Resonance Liberation is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation will also be cast automatically when Snowforged Blade depletes.
Hiyuki deals Glacio DMG. Each point of Snowforged Blade consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart, and ends Foreclaimed Self.
description.id:
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision

Foreclaiming: Inward Vision tersedia setelah menggunakan Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self.
Saat dalam Present Self, tekan Resonance Liberation untuk menggunakan skill ini, memberikan Glacio DMG. Saat skill ini digunakan, mendapat 3 poin Frostharden Iai, menghapus 300 poin Dedication dan Frostheart. Lalu, memasuki Foreclaimed Self dan memulihkan 50 poin Frostheart.
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision memberikan 4 stack Glacio Chafe saat mengenai target.
Menggunakan Foreclaiming: Inward Vision tidak mengonsumsi Resonance Energy.

Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation

Saat dalam Foreclaimed Self, Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation dapat digunakan dengan cara berikut:
- Tekan Resonance Liberation lalu lepas untuk menggunakan Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. Jika Hiyuki memiliki 3 poin Snowforged Blade, konsumsi seluruh Snowforged Blade. Jika tidak, penggunaan ini tidak mengonsumsi Snowforged Blade.
- Tahan Resonance Liberation untuk memasuki kondisi mengisi daya. Selama kondisi ini, mengonsumsi 1 poin Snowforged Blade secara berkala. Lepas Resonance Liberation untuk menggunakan Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. Jika tidak ada Snowforged Blade yang dikonsumsi saat Resonance Liberation dilepas, Hiyuki akan terus mengisi daya serangan dan menggunakan skill secara otomatis setelah waktu tertentu. Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation juga akan digunakan secara otomatis saat Snowforged Blade habis.
Hiyuki memberikan Glacio DMG. Setiap poin Snowforged Blade yang dikonsumsi meningkatkan Pengali DMG serangan ini.
Menggunakan skill ini mengonsumsi 300 poin Dedication dan Frostheart, serta mengakhiri Foreclaimed Self.

description.en:
When a Resonator in the team applies Glacio Chafe or Havoc Bane, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of Snow Rust. Snow Rust stacks up to 3 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of Snow Rust, the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
2 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies Glacio Chafe, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier of 102%.
3 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is additionally Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.
description.id:
Saat Resonator dalam tim memberikan Glacio Chafe atau Havoc Bane, Hiyuki mendapat 1 stack Snow Rust. Snow Rust bertumpuk hingga 3 kali. Setiap Resonator hanya dapat memicu efek ini sekali dengan cara ini.
Berdasarkan stack Snow Rust Hiyuki saat ini, bonus berikut terbuka:
1 stack Snow Rust: Saat Hiyuki menjadi Resonator aktif dalam tim, Glacio Bite DMG di-Amplify sebesar 30% terhadap target dalam jangkauan tertentu. Crit. DMG Hiyuki meningkat sebesar 40%.
2 stack Snow Rust: Saat Hiyuki menjadi Resonator aktif dalam tim, setiap kali ia memberikan Glacio Chafe, ia juga memberikan satu instans Glacio Bite DMG dengan Pengali DMG tetap sebesar 102%.
3 stack Snow Rust: Saat Hiyuki menjadi Resonator aktif dalam tim, Glacio Bite DMG di-Amplify tambahan sebesar 30% terhadap target dalam jangkauan tertentu.
Efek ini diatur ulang saat Resonator baru ditambahkan ke tim.

description.en: Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers after being knocked out, when she stays out of combat for 4s with fewer than 1 point of Snowforged Blade, restore 1 point.
description.id: Setelah Hiyuki keluar dari kondisi tempur atau pulih setelah tumbang, saat ia tetap di luar pertempuran selama 4 dtk dengan kurang dari 1 poin Snowforged Blade, memulihkan 1 poin.

description.en:
Glacio Bite

- While Hiyuki is in the team, Glacio Chafe inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to Glacio Bite. Every time a new stack of Glacio Bite is inflicted on a target, an instance of Glacio Bite DMG is triggered based on that enemy's current Glacio Bite stack limit. Glacio Bite can be inflicted on frozen targets. Glacio Bite is also considered Glacio Chafe and Glacio Bite DMG is also considered Glacio Chafe DMG.
- When Foreclaiming: Inward Vision or Basic Attack - Iai hits a target, if the target has no fewer than 10 stacks of Glacio Bite, consume 10 stacks and trigger Frostbind once.
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of Glacio Chafe from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert Glacio Chafe into Glacio Bite, all enemies' Glacio Bite stacks are cleared.

Present Self

Hiyuki starts in Present Self. While in Present Self, casting certain skills restores Dedication.

Foreclaimed Self

Hiyuki enters Foreclaimed Self after casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. While in Foreclaimed Self, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores Frostheart through certain attacks.

Iai Stance

If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of Frostheart, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter Iai Stance:
- Press Dodge after casting any Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, Frostblight: Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, or Intro Skill - Frostedge.
- Hold Resonance Skill within a certain period after casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave or Frostblight: Petalfall.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters Iai Stance.
Hiyuki may enter Iai Stance while airborne. Upon entering the Iai Stance, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. Iai Stance ends if Hiyuki is switched out.

Basic Attack - Iai

Within a certain period after entering Iai Stance, press Normal Attack and consume 100 points of Frostheart to cast Basic Attack - Iai, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If Frostheart remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a certain period to cast Basic Attack - Iai again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during Basic Attack - Iai, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time Basic Attack - Iai is cast, if Hiyuki has Frostharden Iai, consume 1 point of Frostharden Iai to inflict 3 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit, and gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Dedication

Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of Dedication.
While in Present Self, Dedication may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 restores 100 points of Dedication.
- Casting Intro Skill - Frostedge restores 200 points of Dedication.
Casting Resonance Skill - Present Self enhances the next Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3, which now additionally restores 100 points of Dedication. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.

Frostheart

Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of Frostheart.
Frostheart is restored while casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall, or when Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self hits the target.

Frostharden Iai

Frostharden Iai has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision grants 3 points of Frostharden Iai.

Whiteout Bitterfrost

Whiteout Bitterfrost stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Frostharden Iai is consumed through Basic Attack - Iai, gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Snowforged Blade

Snowforged Blade stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self is cast, gain 1 stack of Snowforged Blade.
description.id:
Glacio Bite

- Selama Hiyuki ada dalam tim, Glacio Chafe yang ditimbulkan Resonator di sekitar dalam tim diubah menjadi Glacio Bite. Setiap kali stack baru Glacio Bite ditimbulkan pada target, satu instans Glacio Bite DMG terpicu berdasarkan batas stack Glacio Bite musuh saat itu. Glacio Bite dapat ditimbulkan pada target yang membeku. Glacio Bite juga dianggap sebagai Glacio Chafe dan Glacio Bite DMG juga dianggap sebagai Glacio Chafe DMG.
- Saat Foreclaiming: Inward Vision atau Basic Attack - Iai mengenai target, jika target memiliki tidak kurang dari 10 stack Glacio Bite, konsumsi 10 stack dan picu Frostbind sekali.
- Saat Hiyuki bergabung ke tim, hapus seluruh stack Glacio Chafe dari target. Saat Hiyuki meninggalkan tim, jika tidak ada Resonator lain dalam tim yang dapat mengubah Glacio Chafe menjadi Glacio Bite, seluruh stack Glacio Bite semua musuh dihapus.

Present Self

Hiyuki memulai dalam Present Self. Saat dalam Present Self, menggunakan skill tertentu memulihkan Dedication.

Foreclaimed Self

Hiyuki memasuki Foreclaimed Self setelah menggunakan Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. Saat dalam Foreclaimed Self, Hiyuki membuka jurus baru dan memulihkan Frostheart melalui serangan tertentu.

Iai Stance

Jika Hiyuki memiliki setidaknya 100 poin Frostheart, melakukan salah satu aksi berikut membuatnya melesat mundur dengan mengonsumsi STA dan memasuki Iai Stance:
- Tekan Dodge setelah menggunakan Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self apa pun selain Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, Frostblight: Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, atau Intro Skill - Frostedge.
- Tahan Resonance Skill dalam waktu tertentu setelah menggunakan Frostblight: Jade Cleave atau Frostblight: Petalfall.
Saat melakukan aksi di atas, jika ada target valid dalam jangkauan dan input maju ditahan, Hiyuki akan melesat ke belakang musuh dengan mengonsumsi STA dan memasuki Iai Stance.
Hiyuki dapat memasuki Iai Stance saat di udara. Saat memasuki Iai Stance, charge Dodge di udara Hiyuki diatur ulang. Iai Stance berakhir jika Hiyuki diganti keluar.

Basic Attack - Iai

Dalam waktu tertentu setelah memasuki Iai Stance, tekan Normal Attack dan konsumsi 100 poin Frostheart untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Iai, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
Jika Frostheart tetap di 100 poin atau lebih setelah menggunakan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Iai lagi.
Jika Hiyuki diserang musuh dalam waktu tertentu selama Basic Attack - Iai, damage tersebut dinetralkan dan Hiyuki kebal terhadap interupsi untuk durasi tertentu setelahnya sambil mengurangi semua DMG yang masuk sebesar 100%.
Setiap kali Basic Attack - Iai digunakan, jika Hiyuki memiliki Frostharden Iai, konsumsi 1 poin Frostharden Iai untuk menimbulkan 3 stack Glacio Chafe saat mengenai target, dan dapatkan 1 stack Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Dedication

Hiyuki dapat menyimpan hingga 300 poin Dedication.
Saat dalam Present Self, Dedication dapat dipulihkan dengan cara berikut:
- Menggunakan Basic Attack - Present Self Tahap 3 memulihkan 100 poin Dedication.
- Menggunakan Intro Skill - Frostedge memulihkan 200 poin Dedication.
Menggunakan Resonance Skill - Present Self meningkatkan Basic Attack - Present Self Tahap 3 berikutnya, yang kini juga memulihkan 100 poin Dedication. Efek ini berakhir saat Hiyuki diganti keluar.

Frostheart

Hiyuki dapat menyimpan hingga 300 poin Frostheart.
Frostheart dipulihkan saat menggunakan Frostblight: Jade Cleave dan Frostblight: Petalfall, atau saat Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self selain Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self mengenai target.

Frostharden Iai

Frostharden Iai memiliki maksimum 3 poin.
Menggunakan Foreclaiming: Inward Vision memberikan 3 poin Frostharden Iai.

Whiteout Bitterfrost

Whiteout Bitterfrost bertumpuk hingga 3 kali.
Setiap kali Frostharden Iai dikonsumsi melalui Basic Attack - Iai, dapatkan 1 stack Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Snowforged Blade

Snowforged Blade bertumpuk hingga 3 kali.
Setiap kali Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self digunakan, dapatkan 1 stack Snowforged Blade.

description.en:
The DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self, Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self, and Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self are increased by 120%.

Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3 now has an increased range and pulls enemies within range toward the center. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions while casting Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 & 5.

Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision enhances the next Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 1 & 2, which now inflict Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self, Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self, dan Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self meningkat sebesar 120%.

Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Tahap 3 kini memiliki jangkauan lebih luas dan menarik musuh dalam jangkauan ke arah tengah. Hiyuki kebal terhadap interupsi saat melakukan Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Tahap 4 & 5.

Menggunakan Foreclaiming: Inward Vision meningkatkan Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Tahap 1 & 2 berikutnya, yang kini menimbulkan Glacio Chafe sebanyak 1 kali saat mengenai target.

description.en:
Basic Attack - Iai's DMG Multiplier is increased by 125%.

Inherent Skill Ephemeral Realm's effect becomes the following one:
Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, restore 3 point of Snowforged Blade.

Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, the following effects are triggered once:
- While in Foreclaimed Self, restore 3 point points of Frostharden Iai.
- Reset the Cooldown of 2 charges of Frostblight: Jade Cleave.
- Restore an additional 50 points of Frostheart for the next 2 cast of Frostblight: Jade Cleave or Frostblight: Petalfall.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Basic Attack - Iai meningkat sebesar 125%.

Efek Inherent Skill Ephemeral Realm berubah menjadi sebagai berikut:
Setelah Hiyuki keluar dari kondisi tempur atau pulih dari tumbang, setelah tetap di luar pertempuran selama 4 dtk, memulihkan 3 poin Snowforged Blade.

Setelah Hiyuki keluar dari kondisi tempur atau pulih dari tumbang, setelah tetap di luar pertempuran selama 4 dtk, efek berikut terpicu sekali:
- Saat dalam Foreclaimed Self, memulihkan 3 poin Frostharden Iai.
- Mengatur ulang Cooldown 2 charge Frostblight: Jade Cleave.
- Memulihkan tambahan 50 poin Frostheart untuk 2 penggunaan Frostblight: Jade Cleave atau Frostblight: Petalfall berikutnya.

description.en:
Inherent Skill Fine Snow gains the following effect:
2s after a Resonator joins the team or Hiyuki is revived, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of Snow Rust. Hiyuki can obtain up to 1 stack of Snow Rust in this way.

The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self and Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self are increased by 160%.

At 2 stacks of Snow Rust, while Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, the DMG Multiplier of the additionally applied Glacio Bite DMG each time she inflicts Glacio Chafe is increased by 488%.
description.id:
Inherent Skill Fine Snow mendapat efek berikut:
2 dtk setelah Resonator bergabung ke tim atau Hiyuki dibangkitkan, Hiyuki mendapat 1 stack Snow Rust. Hiyuki dapat memperoleh hingga 1 stack Snow Rust dengan cara ini.

Pengali DMG Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self dan Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self meningkat sebesar 160%.

Pada 2 stack Snow Rust, saat Hiyuki menjadi Resonator aktif dalam tim, Pengali DMG Glacio Bite DMG tambahan yang diberikan setiap kali ia menimbulkan Glacio Chafe meningkat sebesar 488%.

description.en:
Casting Resonance Skill - Present Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, or Frostblight: Petalfall increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by 20% for 30s.

Restore 18% of Max HP while casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave or Frostblight: Petalfall.
description.id:
Menggunakan Resonance Skill - Present Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, atau Frostblight: Petalfall meningkatkan DMG yang diberikan semua Resonator di sekitar dalam tim sebesar 20% selama 30 dtk.

Memulihkan 18% Max HP saat menggunakan Frostblight: Jade Cleave atau Frostblight: Petalfall.

description.en: The DMG Multipliers of Resonance Skill - Present Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, and Frostblight: Petalfall are increased by 80%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Resonance Skill - Present Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, dan Frostblight: Petalfall meningkat sebesar 80%.

description.en:
The Crit. DMG of Foreclaiming: Inward Vision and Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation is increased by 500%.

At 2 stacks of Snow Rust, the effect "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies Glacio Chafe, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier" changes to "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time a Resonator in the team applies Glacio Chafe, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier."
At 2 stacks of Snow Rust, Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
At 3 stacks of Snow Rust, the total Glacio Bite DMG taken by targets within a certain range of the active Resonator in the team is increased by 25%.
description.id:
Crit. DMG Foreclaiming: Inward Vision dan Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation meningkat sebesar 500%.

Pada 2 stack Snow Rust, efek "Saat Hiyuki menjadi Resonator aktif dalam tim, setiap kali ia memberikan Glacio Chafe, ia juga memberikan satu instans Glacio Bite DMG dengan Pengali DMG tetap" berubah menjadi "Saat Hiyuki menjadi Resonator aktif dalam tim, setiap kali Resonator dalam tim memberikan Glacio Chafe, ia juga memberikan satu instans Glacio Bite DMG dengan Pengali DMG tetap."
Pada 2 stack Snow Rust, Crit. DMG Hiyuki meningkat sebesar 40%.
Pada 3 stack Snow Rust, total Glacio Bite DMG yang diterima target dalam jangkauan tertentu dari Resonator aktif dalam tim meningkat sebesar 25%.
